hero.title: Asking for information is already
hero.description: We always have an open ear for your concerns, questions about what we offer, or proposals for cooperation. Get in touch directly with our team in Castrop-Rauxel and Dortmund.

email.title: Advice by email
email.text: Our team is glad to help with any question and will reply promptly.

locations.title: Locations
locations.text: Visit us at our meeting centre, or arrange an appointment at the network hub.

phone.title: Call us directly
phone.text: Available Monday to Friday, 8:00 to 17:00 without a break.

form.heading: We look forward to hearing from you
form.intro: Tutoring for your child, advice about language courses, volunteering as a tandem partner or institutional cooperation — fill in the form and we will get back to you promptly.
form.privacyText: Your details are treated confidentially and used only to answer your enquiry. They are never passed on to unauthorised third parties.
form.successText: Thank you for getting in touch. Our team will deal with your enquiry shortly.
form.messagePlaceholder: Briefly describe your request or question...

donate.heading: Donate for equal opportunity
donate.text: Every donation goes directly to children and families in North Rhine-Westphalia: school materials, tutors and intercultural leisure activities. We are happy to issue a donation receipt on request.
donate.account: Bank details: ask us for our IBAN via the contact form or by email.

member.heading: Become a member of EFI e.V.
member.text: Join as a full or supporting member. Bring your ideas, your professional skills or your time as a volunteer, and help us build a more supportive society together.
member.benefitVote: A vote at the general meeting
member.benefitReports: Regular internal project and planning reports
member.benefitNetwork: A strong network for diversity and civil society
